scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm start"
scripts.build: cd server && npm install --silent && cd ../client && npm install --silent && npm run build
scripts.install-deps: cd server && npm install --silent && cd ../client && npm install --silent
scripts.deploy-prep: npm run install-deps && npm run build
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd client && npm install --silent && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules package-lock.json server/package-lock.json client/package-lock.json
